queries: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, c, c * 1.0 / SUM(c) OVER () AS share, AVG(c * 1.0) OVER () AS a FROM g) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(c - a) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE c > a

assumptions.assumption: Examinations are joined to patients with an inner join on ID, so examinations with no matching patient are left out. Each sex's share is its count divided by the combined count of all matched examinations. The per-sex average count is taken over every sex group, including the NULL group and the blank-string group, each as its own group.

assumptions.assumption: Examinations are matched to patients with an inner join on ID, so examinations with no matching patient are excluded from the counts and from the combined total used for shares.
The per-sex average count is the simple average of the counts across the SEX groups, which include the NULL group and the empty-string group as separate groups.
